---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency vs. Car Weight",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per Gallon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
